originality.rationale: FAIL due to decisive prior mathematical implication. The 2026-10-13 published RESULT for three consecutive Pell-type numbers proves a more general arbitrary-coprime A<B and C=A+uB first-crossing formula for u>=2 (in its proof, beyond its Pell specialization). Setting p=1 and u=c gives the exact submitted two-layer Apéry threshold for every c>=2 in the claimed domain; its published g_1 coincides. Lemma 1 of Komatsu and Mu (arXiv:2307.08998v2) already derives genus and Sylvester sums mechanically from an Apéry set. The leftover c=1 is covered by the 2026-10-26 complete multiplicity phase for (a,b,a+b), including g_1 and genus; its threshold and Sylvester sum follow from the same elementary finite formulas. The new paper contributes a different simple two-certificate proof but no surviving distinct final invariant.
residual_risks: The 2026-10-13 publication headlines the Pell case, but its proof expressly states and establishes the general coprime A,B,u threshold formula; originality rejection relies on that actual general proof, not title or matching parameters.

The c=1 low-multiplicity case is covered by a published co-generated triple classification. A different short proof of the same values, without a new motivated invariant, remaining stronger statement, or independently valuable structural obstruction, is not an original scientific contribution meeting the value bar. This is a rejection on positive earlier coverage, not a lack of online matches.
